تستأمني (form X)
# تَسْتَأْمِنِي (tastaʔminī) /tas.taʔ.mi.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
# تُسْتَأْمَنِي (tustaʔmanī) /tus.taʔ.ma.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
